cues: You type your symbol number into the board's website and press check.
In your browser, JavaScript checks that you typed a sensible number, instantly.
Then the request travels to the server, where PHP looks you up in a database and builds a page just for you.
text: Results day. You type your symbol number into the board's website and press check. Two kinds of program run. In your browser, JavaScript checks that you typed a sensible number, instantly. Then the request travels to the server, where PHP looks you up in a database and builds a page just for you.
